welcome.noFolder:
Open a folder to find its TODOs.
[Open Folder](command:workbench.action.files.openFolder)
Or scan the files you have open:
[Scan Open Files](command:todoforge.setScanMode)
welcome.empty:
No TODOs here yet. Write one as a comment, for example `// TODO(you, 2026-12-01): cache this`.
[Add a TODO](command:todoforge.addTodo)
[Import Settings from Todo Tree, Rider or Visual Studio](command:todoforge.importSettings)
[Get Started](command:todoforge.openWalkthrough)
welcome.filtered:
No TODOs match this filter.
[Clear Filter](command:todoforge.clearFilter)
welcome.changesNoGit:
Changes lists the TODOs you have not committed yet and the TODOs added on this branch.
It needs a local git repository in a trusted workspace. TodoForge only reads local git; it never fetches or pushes.
welcome.changesEmpty:
No new TODOs. TODOs you add appear here before you commit and stay until your branch is merged.
[Add a TODO](command:todoforge.addTodo)
walkthrough.tree.title: See every TODO
walkthrough.tree.description:
TodoForge scans your workspace with ripgrep and lists TODO, FIXME, HACK and friends, grouped by tag, file or owner. It skips bin, obj and node_modules out of the box.
[Open the TODO view](command:todoforge.tree.focus)
walkthrough.syntax.title: Give TODOs an owner and a date
walkthrough.syntax.description:
Write `TODO(owner, 2026-12-01, !high, #label): text`. Every part is optional. Overdue TODOs turn red, and the hover card has one-click Snooze, Due date and Priority.
[Add a TODO here](command:todoforge.addTodo)
walkthrough.changes.title: Review TODOs you are adding
walkthrough.changes.description:
The Changes view shows TODOs you have not committed and TODOs added on your branch, from local git only. Check it before you open a pull request.
[Show Changes](command:todoforge.changes.focus)
walkthrough.filter.title: Filter as you type
walkthrough.filter.description:
Try `is:mine`, `is:overdue`, `tag:FIXME`, `@name`, `#label` or plain words. Save a filter as a view to reuse it.
[Filter TODOs](command:todoforge.filter)
walkthrough.import.title: Bring your settings
walkthrough.import.description:
Coming from Todo Tree, Rider or Visual Studio? Import your tags in one step.
[Import Settings](command:todoforge.importSettings)
walkthrough.insights.title: See the big picture
walkthrough.insights.description:
Insights counts TODOs by tag, folder and owner, shows their age from git blame, and lists the overdue ones. Everything is computed on your machine.
[Show Insights](command:todoforge.showInsights)
walkthrough.title: Get started with TodoForge
walkthrough.description: Find, organize and finish the TODOs in your code. Offline, no account.
config.general.tags: Comment tags to find. Order sets the color of custom tags.
config.general.strictTags: Tags that are common English words. They only count when followed by `:` or `(`, so `// Note that…` is not a TODO.
config.general.tagGroups: Optional groups of tags, for example `{ "name": "Fix", "tags": ["FIXME", "BUG"] }`. Used when grouping by tag.
config.general.caseSensitive: Match tags with exact case. On by default so `todo` in prose is not a TODO.
config.general.subTagRegex: Regex run on the text after a tag. The first non-empty group becomes the sub-tag, for example `#123` or `@urgent`.
config.general.labelFormat: Tree label. Tokens: `${tag}`, `${text}`, `${file}`, `${line}`, `${subtag}`. When grouping by tag the default shows only the text.
config.regex.custom: Custom regex that replaces the built-in matcher. Put `$TAGS` where the tags go. Leave empty for the language-aware matcher (recommended). Ignored in untrusted workspaces.
config.regex.multiline: Append the following comment lines to a TODO.
config.regex.multilineMaxLines: Maximum extra lines when multiline is on.
config.dotnet.codePatterns: In C# files, also list `throw new NotImplementedException()`, `[Obsolete]` and `#warning`.
config.scanning.mode.openFiles: Scan only files open in editor tabs.
config.scanning.mode.workspaceAndOpen: Workspace plus open files outside it.
config.scanning.includeGlobs: Only scan paths matching these globs. Empty scans every text file that is not excluded.
config.scanning.excludeGlobs: Globs to skip. Defaults skip .NET build output, legacy NuGet package folders, node_modules, generated C# and minified files.
config.scanning.maxFileSizeKb: Skip files larger than this, in KB.
config.scanning.debounceMs: Wait this long after file changes before rescanning them.
config.scanning.autoRefreshIntervalSec: Full rescan interval in seconds. `0` turns it off; file watching keeps the tree current.
config.scanning.refreshOnGitHeadChange: Rescan after a branch switch or pull.
config.highlighting.style.comment: The comment from the comment token to the end of the line.
config.highlighting.inlineHints: Show due dates and high priority after the TODO line, such as `overdue 3d`.
config.highlighting.tags: Per-tag style overrides, for example `{ "TODO": { "foreground": "#ffcc00" } }`. Built-in tags follow your theme; you can also recolor them with `workbench.colorCustomizations` (`todoforge.todoForeground` and so on).
config.tree.sortBy.age: Oldest first, from local git blame.
config.tree.sortBy: How TODOs are ordered inside groups.
config.tree.showActivityBadge: Show the TODO count on the activity bar icon.
config.markdown.enabled: Find Markdown checklist items such as `- [ ] write docs`.
config.markdown.groupSeparately: Show checklist items in their own group.
config.codelens.enabled: Show Pin and Snooze above each TODO.
config.statusbar.enabled: Show the TODO counter in the status bar.
config.statusbar.format.compact: This file / workspace, plus overdue count.
config.problems.enabled: Also list TODOs in the Problems panel.
config.problems.scope: Which files report TODOs to the Problems panel.
config.problems.severity: Problems severity per tag. Others are `information`. Overdue TODOs are at least warnings.
config.syntax.owner: Your name for `TODO(owner)`, `Assign to Me` and `is:mine`. Empty uses your local `git config user.name`.
config.stale.afterDays: A TODO older than this many days (by git blame) is stale.
config.git.enabled: Use local git for the Changes view, blame age and `is:mine`. Only read-only local commands run; nothing is fetched. Off in untrusted workspaces.
config.git.baseBranch: Branch to compare against for "This branch". Empty detects `origin/HEAD`, then `main`, `master`, `develop`.
config.git.blame.onDemand: Blame only when needed: hover, Insights, age sort or `is:mine`.
config.ai.enabled: Opt in to **Explain TODO with AI**. It uses a chat model you already have in VS Code (for example GitHub Copilot) through the Language Model API, after a one-time consent. TodoForge makes no network request itself.
config.ai.chatTools: Let chat agents in VS Code (for example GitHub Copilot agent mode) read your TODOs with the read-only TodoForge tools: list and filter TODOs, list Changes, get one TODO. They run only when you chat and return TODO data from this window, never file contents. Off in untrusted workspaces.
config.migrateFromTodoTree: Offer once to import your Todo Tree settings.
tool.list.userDescription: Find TODO, FIXME, HACK and other tagged comments in this workspace, filtered by file, tag, owner, label, due date, priority or git status.
tool.changes.userDescription: TODOs you have not committed yet and TODOs added on your current branch, from local git.
tool.get.userDescription: Details of one TODO: owner, due date, priority, labels, git author and age, and whether it is new.
ext.displayName: TodoForge – TODO Tree, Highlights & Due Dates
ext.description: Fast, offline TODO and FIXME tree with theme-aware highlights, owners and due dates, quick fixes, a Changes view for your branch and first-class .NET support. No account, no telemetry.
ext.untrusted: In untrusted workspaces TodoForge scans and highlights, but does not run git, ignores a workspace custom regex and turns AI help and chat tools off.
ext.virtual: TodoForge runs ripgrep and git on local files.
